shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a coarse, weathered stone surface
upright monolithic block/slab as the carrying support
curving linear contours defining a raised motif against a plain ground
justification: Both are upright blocks of rough, pitted stone bearing shallow relief in which forms are defined mainly by outline and slight modelling of the ground, and in both the carving is confined to one broad face. Beyond that the content and organisation diverge completely: A is a fully sculpted anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms, a prominent disc and horizontal banding stacked vertically, while B shows a single quadruped in strict horizontal profile isolated on an otherwise blank panel.
